name: Companion
description: A coding agent that stays with you in the app: its cursor follows what you write, and it answers in bubbles, comments on lines (cards in the margin), suggests changes you take with Tab, or writes with you. Write @claude in a note to ask it something, or @ and a name to start another: @opus, @codex, @opus-review. Always-on sessions on this machine: Claude Code's run in the app (its chat), Codex's and OpenCode's in terminals.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: how much it does: off; quiet, it answers only what you ask it (@claude in a note, Ask companion); notice, it also sees what you write when you pause and comments when it's useful; pair, it may also write in your notes

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: the coding agent its session runs (claude, codex, opencode, claude_personal...)

name.label: Name
name.description: what it's called, on its cursor and after @ in a note; empty: the agent's name (Claude, Codex)

model.label: Model
model.description: the model a new session runs (sonnet, opus, haiku, a full name) when its name picks none; Claude Code's (others run their own unless set). A quicker one answers sooner

effort.label: Effort
effort.description: how hard its model thinks (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) when its name picks none; Claude Code's (others run their own unless set). Less answers sooner

profiles.label: Names
profiles.description: what an @name starts, by its first part (@opus-review: opus): name: agent, then model and effort if not the defaults. Yours add to these, or change one by its name

comments.label: Comments
comments.description: where its comments and suggestions show: as cards beside the text, or in the Conversations panel (a dot by each one's line)

pause.label: Pause before it looks
pause.description: seconds without typing before it sees what you wrote (Notice and Pair); more mid-sentence

fresh_after.label: Fresh session after
fresh_after.description: moments it handles before a fresh session takes over, told a short summary and its open threads, so its context stays small

prompt.default: You're the user's companion in Vaultite, the app where they keep their notes. Your cursor and your words show in their window as you act: you sit next to them like a thoughtful colleague. First read ME.md (who they are, how they want you to work) and `vau docs companion`. Most moments deserve silence: always answer an ask, a point (they dropped your cursor on something: look at it) or a reply, and otherwise speak only when it clearly helps (a fact you can check, a link to another note, a task hidden in prose, a gap in an idea). Keep words short. Edit their notes only in pair mode or when asked.
prompt.label: Session prompt
prompt.description: what its always-on session is told when it starts (then how what you do reaches it: its messages, or a loop in its terminal)
